text:
Sofia CS: quick week0 health check for Hightide private/VPC onboarding. Focus: network egress to SIEM, IAM role for cross-account logging, KMS access for decrypt/generate, and audit delivery. Renewal team flagged risk if audit not validated by next Tues. What are blockers?
Priya (Hightide): logs failing to reach our Graylog endpoint; seeing TLS timeouts. Also need the exact role ARN for our sidecar trust policy.
Danny (Network): seeing SYN retries from forwarder subnet to Graylog. Priya, can you confirm collector IPs and whether mTLS required?
Priya (Hightide): collectors are gl-a.hightide.net (3.120.99.21) and gl-b.hightide.net (3.120.99.22). They accept TLS only (no mTLS).
Danny (Network): will open egress to those two IPs and restrict to tcp/6514. ETA 20m. Snippet: aws ec2 authorize-security-group-egress --group-id sg-0d1a2b --protocol tcp --port 6514 --cidr 3.120.99.21/32
Maya (SE): IAM role to use: arn:aws:iam::444333222111:role/hightide-log-writer. KMS: we need to allow kms:Decrypt and kms:GenerateDataKey for that role and restrict by encryption context key "stream":"hightide-audit".
Ethan (Security): agreed. Policy sample: {"Sid":"AllowHightideLogs","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::444333222111:role/hightide-log-writer"},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:EncryptionContext:stream":"hightide-audit"}}} Apply to the CMK.
Maya (SE): propose key rotation window Fri 01:00 UTC. Priya, ok?
Priya (Hightide): Fri 01:00 UTC works. We'll pause ingestion for ~10m.
Sofia CS: actions: 1) Danny apply egress to Graylog IPs (ETA 20m). 2) Ethan to post final KMS JSON (ETA 2h). 3) Maya schedule rotation Fri 01:00 UTC and invite Hightide. 4) Priya to paste a post-rotation sample. Note: renewal risk stands until audit stream + rotation validated by EOD Fri.
monitor-bot: forwarder-job #2245 started -> running
Danny (Network): egress rules applied, verified TCP connect to both collectors from test instance.
monitor-bot: forwarder-job #2245 finished -> status: success, 0 errors
Priya (Hightide): post-change test shows 200s now. sample: "{\"ts\":\"2026-03-25T09:14:12Z\",\"status\":200,\"msg\":\"ingest accepted\"}"
Sofia CS: great progress, marking thread in-flight. I'll post a short pre-renewal health note tomorrow. If anything slips, escalate to CS manager.
